import json, re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/ADOBE_2018_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data.get('texts', data)
patterns=re.compile(r'principal executive offices|principal executive office|executive offices|zip', re.I)
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    s=t.get('text','') if isinstance(t,dict) else str(t)
    if patterns.search(s):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'TEXT',s)
PY"
